name: Neufund
description: Former blockchain-based equity fundraising platform. Neufund announced its closure in January 2022 and discontinued platform access on 17 January 2022.
statusNote: Documented closure announced by Neufund; not a merger or acquisition.
evidenceNote: Neufund’s own closure FAQ states that platform access ended on 17 January 2022. Closure is recorded independently of M&A exit status.
